NormalExit.Method: Only synthetic action was quit after the resource capture. No actual-input or physical-key claim.

UnavailableMetrics: Private working set and GPU memory are not read by this high-frequency sampler; use the separate steady-state collector.
Slint internal GPU texture/glyph cache allocation is not exposed.
Limitations: Sampled maxima are lower bounds on instantaneous peaks. Processes born and exited between enumerations may be missed.
Each tree snapshot reads processes sequentially; Complete means every discovered descendant was readable, not an atomic kernel snapshot.
Creation identity excludes reused PIDs. Previously observed descendants remain tracked after their parent exits; an unobserved orphan cannot be assigned safely.
Startup begins before the first snapshot; the initial unsampled gap and observed polling intervals are reported. This is a warm-cache observation, never a strict cold-start sample.
PrivateBytes is private commit. Summed working sets double-count shared pages. Observer CPU belongs to the PowerShell collector, separate from the application.
The requested polling interval trades observer cost against missed short peaks; review actual intervals and ObserverCPUPercentOfMachine.
Scan timing comes from app events or logs and is reported separately; incomplete scan evidence is not inferred as a measured scan peak.
